tools.name: peer_actions_log
tools.title: Peer Actions Log
tools.description: Append one row to the Peer-Actions Registry Google Sheet (tab Peer-Actions Registry, columns When | Acting Seat | Requesting Seat | Request (Source) | Action Taken | Result).  When is Central time.  The fleet Google service account is read from Infisical Fleet-OPS /google-sheets-sa (GOOGLE_SHEETS_SA) through a scoped service token — the JSON is never printed.  Use after acting on a peer request.

acting_seat.description: Seat that took the action.  Defaults to the verified identity when omitted.

requesting_seat.description: Seat that made the peer request.

result.description: Outcome (done, declined, partial, error, and why).

dry_run.description: Validate and return the row without appending.
